name: mad
description: MAD — multi-agent debate orchestrator for code review. Current slice: opencode adapter, roster resolution, parallel heterogeneous discovery over N models, finding clustering with co-discovery counted over distinct pool authors, severity-aware threshold routing that marks contested findings for debate, and per-finding debate in sparse rooms with turns batched one per model per round, ending in exactly one recorded exit — converged, stalled, or round cap — under a token ledger that answers "may I spend?" and surfaces rather than drops what the budget stranded (the judge stage is not in this slice). Ships the CAP-1 recall harness over a seeded-defect change and the CAP-2 over-merge/under-merge harness over a hand-labelled pair set.
